name: Agile Robots H10-W
summary: A 230 kg wheeled assistant robot with a height-adjustable humanoid torso and two torque-sensing 7-DOF Diana 3 arms that picks, carries and places objects on voice command.

germany.statusNote: MegaRobotics (Kaarst), which calls itself an official Agile Robots distributor, lists the H10-W with price and availability on request. The product page sits on Agile Robots' Chinese website.

sellers.name: MegaRobotics (MEGAFORCE GmbH, Kaarst)
sellers.note: "Beschaffung auf Anfrage" / "Preis & Verfügbarkeit anfragen"; calls itself an official Agile Robots distributor (not verified with the maker).

specs.label: Degrees of freedom (without hands)
specs.conditions: two 7-DOF arms plus torso lift and head
specs.quote: DoF: 21+ in total (optional 2-finger gripper or dexterous hand)

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 2D and 3D LiDAR, 4 depth cameras (head, wrists, base), 6-axis IMU, microphone array
specs.quote: 2D LiDAR 3D LiDAR 4 depth cameras (head/wrists/base-mounted) 6-axis IMU microphone array and speaker

specs.label: Communication interface
specs.value: Fast DDS, gRPC, up to 1 kHz
specs.quote: Fast DDS, gRPC, up to 1 kHz

notes: Dual-wheel differential-drive base with a torso that moves up and down; arms are Agile Robots Diana 3 torque-sensing arms.
End effector is an option: two-finger gripper or dexterous hand.
Takes voice commands for pick, carry and place tasks.

openQuestions: Price, runtime and battery capacity are not published.
Whether the H10-W is sold by Agile Robots SE in Europe or only via its Chinese business; CE status not stated.
Could also be classed as a mobile manipulator (wheeled base with a humanoid torso).
